title: [Chapitre] VI. Analysis situs (deuxième mouture) : notes manuscrites (18-20/06/1986).

errors: As transcribed, the NB says At 11 bis 'implique At 11' outright. At 11 bis only concerns filtered families, so it cannot give arbitrary sups alone. The correct logic, consistent with p.79 (At 11 ⇔ At 11 bis + At 11'), is: At 11 ⇒ At 11 bis, and At 11 bis + At 11' ⇒ At 11. This is most likely a transcription issue or a slip.

The reduced systems silently need At 11' to be derivable. It is: from At 9_Σ + At 10 in system (I), and from At 12 in system (II), as recorded on p.79. So the reduction is coherent, but only given those earlier implications, which are not proved on this page.
The meaning of the 'local finiteness' remark is unclear from the handwriting; no gap can be assessed there.

ideas.what: Replacing an axiom on existence of arbitrary sups of refinements by: finite sups (At 11') plus locally-detected filtered sups (At 11 bis).
ideas.modern_name: Decomposition of arbitrary joins into finite joins and directed joins (as in frames/dcpos); local existence of directed colimits
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard order theory / lattice theory (folklore; continuous lattices, Scott et al. 1970s)

ideas.what: Two minimal equivalent axiom systems for an atlas of figures: {At 9_Σ, At 10, At 11 bis} and {At 9, At 11 bis, At 12}.
ideas.modern_name: Axiomatics of a 'tame topology' / atlas of figures (Grothendieck's own unpublished framework)

ideas.what: Recovering compatibility with all limits (At 9_{Σ̄}, Σ̄ = all ordered sets) by building it into the definition of a saturated atlas.
ideas.modern_name: Saturation / completion of an atlas, akin to passing to a maximal atlas or a sheafification-type closure
ideas.usually_credited_to: General practice (maximal atlases in differential topology; completion constructions)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme mentions tame topology only programmatically

missed.claim: The precise definition of a 'saturated atlas' including At 9_{Σ̄} is announced but deferred on this page. Whether saturation actually exists and preserves the other axioms is left open here. It is part of the broader, never-published Analysis situs axiomatics of tame topology.
missed.quote: Il faudra le récupérer pendant au passage à la saturation de l'Atlas, en n'oubliant pas, dans la définition d'un atlas saturé, d'inclure At 9' = At 9_{Σ̄}
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Only of interest to someone reconstructing Grothendieck's tame-topology axiomatics, compared with o-minimal structures or stratified-space frameworks. The page itself is routine bookkeeping.

deep.surprise_reason: The page reorganizes axioms using the standard 'all joins = finite joins + directed joins' trick, made local. It is internal bookkeeping of an unpublished framework, with no new mathematical result beyond that.
transcription_corrections: Line after 'NB': the reading 'Ce résultat implique At 11, et se implique At 11 moyennant At 11'' is garbled. Logically it should be 'est impliqué par At 11, et implique At 11 moyennant At 11' (condition de compatibilité)'. The image is ambiguous, but this reading matches p.79.

'Les condition sympathique, c'est de inclure la condition "condition de locale finitude"' is more plausibly 'La conversion sympathique, c'est d'inclure le caractère "condition de locale finitude"' (uncertain).
'Ainsi, on a-t-on [?] des axiomes à nouveau "réduits"' is probably 'Ainsi, on a 2 systèmes d'axiomes "réduits" :'. The two systems listed are {At 9_Σ, At 10, At 11 bis} and {At 9, At 11 bis, At 12}.
In the second list, the crossed-out item is illegible. At 10 is genuinely absent from the final system, as confirmed by the margin note 'ici At 10 disparaît'.
'un peu dépendant [?]' may read 'un peu dépendant des limites', i.e. dependent on the choice of Σ.
